mapper.select:
select wji.product as "product", wji.batch as "batch", wji.job_id as "job_id", wji.job_ins_id as "job_ins_id", wti.task_id as "task_id", wti.task_ins_id as "task_ins_id", wti.task_state as "task_state", wti.title as "task_title" from ww_job_instance wji,ww_task_instance wti where wji.job_id = wti.job_id and wji.job_ins_id = wti.job_ins_id
and wji.product = #{product}
and wji.batch = #{batch}
and instr(wji.batch,#{lBatch}) > 0
and instr(wji.job_id,#{lJobId}) > 0
and instr(wji.job_ins_id,#{lJobInsId}) > 0
and instr(wti.task_id,#{lTaskId}) > 0
and instr(wti.task_ins_id,#{lTaskInsId}) > 0
and instr(wti.task_state,#{taskState}) > 0
and wti.task_state < 20
and instr(wti.title,#{lTaskTitle}) > 0
and exists ( select tsupr.product_id From ww_sys_user tsu,ww_product tp,ww_sys_user_product_ref tsupr where tsu.login_name=tsupr.user_id and tp.p_id=tsupr.product_id and tp.p_id=wji.product and tsu.login_name=#{loginName} )
order by wji.product,wji.batch,wji.job_id,wji.job_ins_id,wti.task_id,wti.task_ins_id
mapper.delete: delete from ww_task_instance where job_ins_id in (select job_ins_id from ww_job_instance j where j.batch = #{batch} and j.product = #{product})
delete from ww_task_instance_lean where job_ins_id in (select job_ins_id from ww_job_instance j where j.batch = #{batch} and j.product = #{product})
delete from ww_task_instance where job_ins_id in (select job_ins_id from ww_job_instance j where j.product = #{product})

delete from ww_task_instance where 1=1
and job_ins_id = #{jobInsId}

delete from ww_task_instance_lean where 1=1
and job_ins_id = #{jobInsId}
delete from ww_task_instance_lean where job_ins_id in (select job_ins_id from ww_job_instance j where j.product = #{product})
mapper.select: select t1.lean_task_ins_id task_ins_id, t2.task_state from ww_task_instance_lean t1 left join ww_task_instance t2 on t1.lean_task_ins_id = t2.task_ins_id and t1.job_ins_id = t2.job_ins_id where t1.job_ins_id = #{jobInsId} and t1.task_ins_id = #{taskInsId}
select task_ins_id from ww_task_instance_lean where lean_task_ins_id = #{taskInsId} and job_ins_id = #{jobInsId}

select IF(t.title is null or t.title = '', '其他', t.title) as 'TITLE', COUNT(1) AS 'TOTAL_COUNT', COUNT(IF(t.task_state = 16, TRUE, NULL)) as 'FAILED_COUNT', COUNT(IF(t.task_state > 19, TRUE, NULL)) as 'PASSED_COUNT' from ww_job_instance j,ww_task_instance t where j.job_ins_id = t.job_ins_id and j.product = #{product} and j.batch = #{batch} group by t.title

select DECODE(t.title,NULL,'其他','','其他',t.title) as title, COUNT(1) as total_count, COUNT(DECODE(t.task_state,16,1,NULL)) failed_count, COUNT(DECODE(SIGN(t.task_state-19),1,1,NULL)) passed_count from ww_job_instance j,ww_task_instance t where j.job_ins_id = t.job_ins_id and j.product = #{product} and j.batch = #{batch} group by t.title

select t.job_ins_id, t.job_id, t.task_ins_id, t.task_id, t.task_state, t.batch, t.task_name, t.use_job_dimension, t.task_plugin, t.program_name, t.error_delay, t.error_ignore, t.error_max_num, t.error_current_num, t.period, t.working_day, t.task_result, t.information, t.next_execute_time, t.agent_scope, t.agent, t.task_parameter, t.begin_time, t.end_time, t.create_time, t.creator, t.allowed_rerun from ww_task_instance t where t.job_ins_id = #{jobInsId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and t.task_ins_id = #{taskInsId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
